peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.8% above its local comparables; 70 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (65.3): 5.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 69 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $820,000 ($1,586 psf, 441–559 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,528 psf (range $1,328–2,026); 3.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $30,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Simei MRT about 110 m, Upper Changi MRT about 840 m; closer than 106 of 116 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Changkat Primary School about 220 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 120 m), more than 81 of 116 similar developments (the same as 17); nearest hawker centre Tampines Round Market And Food Centre about 1,060 m; nearest park Sun Plaza Park about 1,970 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Tampines Round Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Pinery Residences, 552 new sales, about 1,610 m; Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 1,750 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 33 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,111 new sales and 520 resales (1,631 purchases); new sales were 68.1% of these purchases. Subsales (10) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,880 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 520 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 86 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 520 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 642 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
